caption:
🎉 Here is the final list final participants of Silkway Accelerator 1.3! 🚀 15 best startups from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan and Mongolia will have a chance to participate in region's benchmarck acceleration program in Astana for three months.

👏 Congratulations to TASS VISION, Voiceloft, BILLZ, Proportunity.kz, Kid Security, TrustContract, ApartX, EZapp - Mobile Orders, Bilimber, Squares, Kwaaka, Garderob, Let's Codify, ProsperPay and Cody! You have shown the huge potential to grow and scale and we are looking forward to your big results.

🔥A total of 280 applications were submitted from the technologically advanced startup projects from Central Asia, Mongolia, Azerbaijan and Georgia. The projects were evaluated by a special committe, which included experts from Central Asian countries and representatives of Google for Startups. 

💥 As part of the Silkway Accelerator 1.3 program, Astana Hub will provide free accommodation for two team members for the whole duration of the program, visa support for international participants, as well as training and mentoring from Google for Startups and Astana Hub. This is a great opportunity for participants to gain valuable experience, expand their knowledge and network in the industry.

👉 Stay tuned to learn more about Silkway Accelerator 1.3!
